metadata.title: Contract-First API Prompt Template for the Bridgewater Customer 360 API
metadata.learning_outcome: Design a contract-first OpenAPI specification that acts as an anti-corruption layer, exposing clean, modern resources while hiding the structure, naming, and data quality problems of a legacy database

behavior: use stable, widely accepted REST and OpenAPI conventions
use meaningful, domain-oriented names in camelCase
never expose legacy table names, column names, or codes
avoid unnecessary variation or alternative solutions

instructions.primary_task: generate an OpenAPI {{openapi_version}} specification in {{output_format}} for a read-only Customer 360 API on top of the Bridgewater County Utilities legacy database defined in {{legacy_sql}}, and save it to api/bridgewater.{{output_format}}
steps: set the API title to Bridgewater API
read the CREATE TABLE statements and comments in {{legacy_sql}} and identify the domain concepts behind each legacy table and column
use the CODETBL rows in {{legacy_sql}} to translate legacy codes into readable values
inspect the INSERT statements in {{legacy_sql}} to find the actual values, formats, and inconsistencies in each column
define the resources GET /customers, GET /customers/{customerId}, GET /customers/{customerId}/bills, GET /customers/{customerId}/summary, and GET /customers/{customerId}/tickets
define reusable schemas for Customer, Bill, CustomerSummary, Ticket, a pagination envelope, and an error body using application/problem+json
represent dates as ISO 8601 strings, billing periods as YYYY-MM strings, amounts as decimal dollars, and phone numbers in E.164 format
represent customer status, service type, and payment status as readable enums, and include UNKNOWN wherever legacy values cannot be mapped with confidence
add page and size query parameters to every collection endpoint, with a default size of {{page_size}} and a maximum of 100
document the 200, 400, 404, and 503 responses for every endpoint, with an example for each
document ETag and Cache-Control response headers and support If-None-Match with a 304 response
include servers, tags, and a version prefix of /v1 in every path

openapi_version.description: the OpenAPI specification version to target

output_format.description: the serialization format of the generated specification

legacy_sql.description: the path to the legacy SQL script containing the schema and seed data

page_size.description: the default number of items returned per page on collection endpoints

rules: do not execute any command until all required inputs are collected
do not modify {{legacy_sql}} or any database created from it
echo each command before executing it
